faq.a: Sussex House at 1551 Foster Street, 1581 Foster Street, 1550 Martin Street and 1580 Martin Street was built 2004–2005 by Rykon Group, per the MLS® strata building record.
Sussex House is 8 storeys with 150 in the strata.

faq.q: What amenities does Sussex House have?
faq.a: Secured underground parking, elevators, an exercise centre, a garden and a guest suite.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.
